messages:
Priya (AE): Hey team — Acme procurement returned the SIG. They flagged Q4.2 (encryption at rest), Q5.1 (KMS rotation proof), and Q9.x (EU data residency). We need an evidence bundle + a short cover note for vendor risk. Can security/eng own the evidence slices?
Jordan (Security): I can take Q4.2 and Q5.1. For Q4.2 we'll provide an encryption-at-rest overview, algorithm list (AES-256), disk and object store configs, and a snippet of our config. I'll attach the SOC2 control mapping.
Priya (AE): Awesome — customer also wants a signed statement on key ownership and whether BYOK is supported.
Terry (Eng): For KMS rotation logs I can export CloudTrail events filtered for KMS and rotation events. Command I ran:```aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=RotateKey --start-time '2025-12-01' --end-time '2026-02-28' > kms-rotation.json``` I'll transform to CSV and upload to s3: s3://redwood-evidence/sig/acme/kms-rotation-2026-02.csv
Jordan (Security): Perfect — please also include key aliases, creation timestamps, and a short diagram showing the KMS flow for Hosted vs Private (customer KMS/HSM integration).
Priya (AE): Also procurement asked whether HSM-backed keys are supported in Private. Need exact wording.
Jordan (Security): Yes — supported. I'll draft a one-paragraph answer + architecture diagram. Wording will mention HSM-backed keys via customer-managed KMS in Private deployments and enterprise-hosted options.
AuditBot: New file uploaded: s3://redwood-evidence/sig/ACME/soc2-mapping-2026-02.pdf
Sam (AE): For the EU residency question we need to confirm where logs, backups, and model cache live. Terry, can you capture region tags for buckets, DB replicas, and model storage?
Terry (Eng): On it — commands I'll use:```aws s3api get-bucket-location --bucket redwood-models-prod | jq .LocationConstraint``` and ```aws rds describe-db-instances --db-instance-identifier redwood-analytics-prod | jq .DBInstances[].AvailabilityZone``` Expectation: models in eu-west-1, backups replicated per customer region rules.
Priya (AE): I'll compile a cover letter for vendor risk summarizing answers and attach the artifacts (kms-rotation CSV, soc2 mapping PDF, KMS diagram). Goal: send to Acme by EOD tomorrow.
Jordan (Security): I'll add a controls traceability matrix mapping SIG sections to SOC2/ISO controls (short table) so vendor risk can cross-check.
Priya (AE): @Jordan (Security) please confirm the exact BYOK phrasing for procurement — they need sentence-level acceptance.
Jordan (Security): Confirmed: "Redwood supports customer-supplied keys (BYOK) in Private deployments via customer-managed KMS/HSM integration. Hosted enterprise plans can be configured to use customer-managed keys; contact your account team for onboarding details." :white_check_mark:
Priya (AE): Thanks — I'll upload the bundle to Confluence and ping the Acme procurement contact. Confluence link (upload space): https://confluence.redwood.com/display/SEC/ACME+SIG+Bundle
Sam (AE): I'll follow up with procurement after the upload. :thumbsup:
Priya (AE): Uploading now and will DM once live. End of thread.
